experiment: scoped foreground repair of the existing one-shot
result: partial visual effect; no acceptable correction
region_detection: Agent visual analysis of the original artwork, checked against the user's two orange annotations. No independent automatic detector was evaluated.
backend: Existing configured ComfyUI worker; pinned FLUX.2 Klein 4B BF16 stack, four steps, Euler, CFG 1, seed 260914201. No new models or runtime installed.

operator_annotation.role: Location and direction guide only; orange strokes must not enter final artwork. Added as a model reference only in B and C.

variants.change: Text-guided masked latent inpainting, followed by exact outside-mask restoration.
findings: New pointed grass section crosses the lower-left belly.
The upper blade remains behind the extended arm.
The original black body outline remains visible across the new green belly blade.

variants.change: Add the operator annotation as a second visual reference and explain its role; original, masks, seed, models and sampler remain fixed.
findings: The lower blade gains only a tiny, inadequate tip at the body edge.

variants.change: Replace only B's masked sampling latent with an empty target. Both references, prompt, models, seed, sampler and final protection mask remain unchanged.
findings: The raw result generates a much too long, nearly horizontal blade across the belly and leaks two orange guide fragments on the right.
The bounded result prevents those extensive changes, but clips the different geometry into visible seams and light wedges at the repair boundaries.
Free synthesis can produce occlusion; it does not establish precise local contour continuity.

verification.visual_inspection: For each variant: raw image, native Pikachu card and full text-free master. Exact original source and operator annotation also viewed. No complete nine-card visual approval is claimed for the rejected variants.
verification.technical_evidence_status_note: The immutable creation-time evidence files retain visual_review=pending. The separate agent verdicts in this report complete that inspection with rejection; they do not alter the job seals.

decision: Stop this three-variant experiment. Keep one-shot primary; do not promote any repair or start other-set generation. A new repair attempt needs a different, more precise control mechanism, not unbounded prompt/seed retries.
remaining_human_review: Pikachu's original appearance remains accepted. The requested grass correction is unresolved. Relaxo, Evoli and the full panorama remain unapproved; PDF and release gates are separate.
